title: Ball-handling proof
blueprint: Handles program (Jan-Mar) · Notion P1 'ball handling proof video'
goal: Prove the handles we teach work against a defender; lead into January handles program

shots.vo: Anyone can dribble alone. Can you do it with a defender on you?
At Fluid, every handle we teach gets tested live.
Stay low. Keep it tight to the body.
Change your pace, not just your hand.
That's how a move goes from the warm-up into the game.
